title: Sheafified pure section of ordinary scalar extension
statement: Let $J$ be a small site, and let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings. Use the categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Ordinary scalar extension $S\otimes_R M$ is the sheafification of the presheaf $U\mapsto S(U)\otimes_{R(U)}M(U)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $E:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ be a functor with specified object equalities $h_M:E(M)=S\otimes_R M$. For every $R$-module sheaf $M$, site object $U$, $s\in S(U)$ and $x\in M(U)$, define its pure scalar-extension section in $E(M)(U)$ to be the image of $s\otimes x$ under the sheafification unit, followed by the section map of the canonical equality isomorphism $h_M^{-1}:S\otimes_R M\to E(M)$. This is the actual section defined by this formula, with no finite-free, flatness or nonzero hypothesis. Site object and morphism universes $c,v$ and additional coefficient universe $r$ are independent, and rings and module sections lie in universe $\max(c,v,r)$.
